title: Team offsite: facts that change over the conversation
note: must: every regex must match the reply (case-insensitive). must_not: a match fails the probe unless its 'unless' regex matches in the rest of its sentence, before or after it (e.g. 'was CAD 18,500', 'because the week of March 9 clashes'). Task checks read the task reply plus its tool-call arguments (a file it wrote). {file}, {version} and {option2} are filled at probe time: any saved file's id prefix, name or title, any saved version, and the second option named in turn 3's reply; a check whose slot is unknown is reported as unchecked.
turns: I'm planning a team offsite for my analytics team. 14 people. Budget is CAD 18,500 all-in. One person, Priya, uses a wheelchair, so every venue must be step-free.
Dates: we're thinking the week of March 9.
Draft me a short page listing three venue options within two hours of Toronto.
Drop the second option. The owner told me their elevator is out until April.
Actually move the dates to the week of March 23. March 9 clashes with quarter close.
Dinner on night one needs to work for two vegans.
Unrelated: suggest a name for our team Slack channel.
Finance approved more: the budget is now CAD 21,000.
Update the page with the new dates and budget.
Unrelated: what's a quick way to explain p-values to a non-technical manager? Two sentences.
Unrelated: give me three icebreaker questions.
Unrelated: what's a good structure for a 30-minute retro?
Unrelated: one tip for running a hybrid meeting.

probes.question: How many people are coming, and what can we spend?
When is it, and why then?
probes.truth: The week of March 23; moved from March 9 because March 9 clashes with quarter close.

probes.question: Remind me of every hard requirement I gave you for the venues.
probes.truth: Step-free for Priya, who uses a wheelchair; 14 people; within two hours of Toronto; CAD 21,000 all-in; dinner on night one works for two vegans.

probes.question: Which venues did we rule out, and why?
probes.truth: The second option of the three, because its elevator is out until April.

probes.question: Tell me everything you know about the attendees.
probes.truth: 14 people on the analytics team; Priya uses a wheelchair; two are vegan.

probes.question: Did I tell you which city the team is flying in from?
probes.truth: No. Only that venues must be within two hours of Toronto.

probes.question: Which file are we working on, which version is it, and what changed last?
probes.task: Write the invitation email to the team.
probes.truth: The venue page; its newest version; the last change set the dates to the week of March 23 and the budget to CAD 21,000.
